name: ProWritingAid
description_en:
ProWritingAid now presents a toolkit for storytellers spanning planning, a writing routine, story critique and line editing. Grammar and style reports sit alongside story-level analysis rather than constituting the entire product.

The useful distinction is between improving sentences and evaluating a manuscript’s structure. A clean line edit cannot establish that a plot works, while an automated story critique remains feedback for the author to interpret.
description_zh:
ProWritingAid 现定位故事作者工具，覆盖规划、写作习惯、故事点评及逐句编辑。语法和风格报告只是部分能力，另有故事层分析。

应区分句子改进与手稿结构评估，句子无误不证明情节有效，自动故事点评也只是作者需判断的反馈。

core_features.explanation_en: Review grammar, style, repetition and readability suggestions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 审核语法、风格、重复及可读性建议。

core_features.explanation_en: Use chapter feedback or separately credited manuscript analysis.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用章节反馈或另计额度的手稿分析。

en: Revise an English chapter while preserving dialogue and authorial voice.
zh: 修订英语章节并保护对话及作者声音。

steps.zh: 检查章节副本，比较建议并验证文件往返后再采用。

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Keep sentence editing separate from developmental changes
sections.en: For an illustrative chapter, first identify scene purpose and character decisions, then inspect line-level suggestions. Dialogue may deliberately break formal grammar; accept changes selectively and compare voice before and after. A report comparing an author’s prose to other writers is not proof of literary quality or a requirement to imitate them.
sections.zh: 例如章节，先明确场景目的与人物决定，再看逐句建议。对话可有意不合正式语法，应选择接受并比较声音。与其他作者文风比较不证明文学质量，也不是模仿要求。

sections.title_en: Count critiques separately from unlimited editing
sections.title_zh: 点评次数和不限编辑分别计算
sections.en: Free checks 500 words at once, offers two runs per line report/day and ten rephrases/day. Monthly Premium is $30 and Premium Pro $36; yearly totals are $120/$144, lifetime $399/$699. Premium includes one chapter critique/day versus thirty on Pro. Full-manuscript Story Credits and plagiarism checks are separate purchases, so unlimited reports do not cover every analysis.
sections.zh: 免费每次查 500 词、各逐句报告每日 2 次、改写 10 次。月付 Premium $30、Premium Pro $36；年总 $120/$144，终身 $399/$699。章节点评每日 1/30 次，整稿 Story Credits 及抄袭检查另购，不限报告不含全部分析。

sections.title_en: Match language, license and refund conditions
sections.title_zh: 核对语言、许可及退款条件
sections.en: The FAQ specifies English variants only and an individual-user license across multiple devices. Yearly/lifetime refunds require contacting support within three days; monthly plans are nonrefundable and cancelling alone does not request a refund. Story Credits are generally nonrefundable with a narrow unused-credit exception for a qualifying new subscription. Validate the actual app integration and document round trip before editing the only copy.
sections.zh: FAQ 仅支持英语变体，许可为单人跨设备。年/终身退款需三天内联系，月付不退，仅取消不等于申请退款。Story Credits 通常不退，符合新订阅退款时未用额度有窄例外。在唯一原稿编辑前应核集成和文件往返。

sections.title_en: Use feedback without outsourcing editorial judgment
sections.title_zh: 使用反馈但保留编辑判断
sections.en: The platform merits evaluation for English-language fiction revision and sustained writing practice. Try a chapter with dialogue, intentional repetition and known continuity issues. No report, critique, integration, export or privacy assertion was tested. Automated beta-reader or marketability feedback cannot guarantee readers, publication or sales.
sections.zh: 英语小说修订及持续写作可评估该平台。应测试含对话、有意重复及已知连续性问题的章节。本文未测报告、点评、集成、导出或隐私，自动读者/市场反馈不能保证读者、出版或销售。

research_gaps: No report, story critique, integration, document round-trip or refund tested.
Actual credit price/consumption, privacy contract, source license and self-hosting unverified.
